messages:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in 5xx responses for /v1/generate across US regions (rate: 3.8% over 2m). Pager triggered for eng-oncall.
ashley (oncall): taking this. thanks bot. pinging devon for context. :eyes:
devon (prev-oncall): thx ash. noticed this started ~20m after the CDN edge config rollout. We saw a flurry of 502/504 from upstream edge-proxy -> our origin, mostly in us-west-2. No deploy on our side at that time.
matt (sre): confirmation — logs show backend returned 502 with header X-Upstream-Node: edge-proxy-23. Error distribution by path attached to alert (most on /v1/generate).
ashley (oncall): ok, immediate mitigation options? can we route traffic away from edge-proxy-23 or enable fallback routing?
devon (prev-oncall): we can modify routing policy to bubble to secondary pool for that node group. quick command: `redwood route set --pool default,secondary --exclude edge-proxy-23` but that might cause brief reconvergence.
matt (sre): suggestion: short-term avoid the failing upstream at LB level. ops-bot, can we mark edge-proxy-23 as unhealthy?
ops-bot: Marking edge-proxy-23 unhealthy in load balancer (in progress) — will return status.
liaison-aws: seeing elevated 5xx at our edge as well; opening ticket with CDN provider (ticket #CDN-8892). They report a partial config propagation issue.
ashley (oncall): good. I'm going to mute the noisy alert to stop repeat pages while we mitigate — but we should not lose visibility. Will create a reduced-severity alert.
ashley (oncall): `alerts mute alert_id=5xx-high --reason "ongoing upstream flapping, muting pages while we remediate" --until 2103460200`
ashley (oncall): creating a temporary metric alert: `5xx_rate_high_incident` -> notify channel only (no page) for now.
matt (sre): agree. also add a short-term dashboard panel for 5xx by upstream node and path. I'll create one in Grafana and link it here.
product-rotations: heads up — customers on Dedicated may see higher error rates; need comms if this persists >30m.
devon (prev-oncall): ops-bot just confirmed LB removed edge-proxy-23 from rotation. backend 5xx rate dropped to ~1.2% in last 60s but still fluctuating.
ashley (oncall): monitoring. adding correlation: increased generator latency accompanying 502s for requests with seq_len>1024. Might be hitting a proxy timeout + queueing.
matt (sre): good catch. can we temporarily lower max-request-timeout on the gateway to fail fast rather than queue? That would reduce downstream cascading.
ashley (oncall): `gateway config set --max-request-timeout 8s --scope us-west` — applying now.
ops-bot: gateway config applied to us-west.
liaison-aws: CDN provider responded: "we had propagation race on edge config; fixed two minutes ago, new configs reaching all POPs." they recommend we re-enable the node when stable.
devon (prev-oncall): reenable edge-proxy-23 in 10 mins if errors stay low.
ashley (oncall): putting that in runbook checklist. creating follow-up ticket: TCK-452: investigate edge config propagation and gateway timeout interplay.
matt (sre): Post-incident tuning notes we should agree on now: 1) Change pager threshold from absolute 5xx > 1% over 2m to 1% over 5m to reduce noise for short upstream blips. 2) Add alert for 5xx spike localized to single upstream (so we page SRE on provider-level failures). 3) Create dashboard split by upstream node and by path, with latency histograms.
ashley (oncall): +1 to all. For immediate change I'm going to: adjust the page window to 5m and add a dependency so provider-specific spikes route to infra-team (non-page) first.
ashley (oncall): `alerts update 5xx_main --window 300 --page-team infra --page-threshold 2%` (doing a staged update).
ashley (oncall): updated. Will monitor for 10m before finalizing.
matt (sre): add a synthetic check against `/v1/health` routed through CDN and direct path; if CDN-only fails we classify as upstream provider incident.
devon (prev-oncall): also propose we add a small cooldown for repeated pager re-escalation: if the same alert fires >3x in 15m, escalate to oncall lead. Prevents thundering pages.
product-rotations: is there any customer impact? do we need a status page incident?
ashley (oncall): current impact: transient 5xx affecting ~0.8% of requests overall, concentrated in US-west for ~15 mins. No data loss, retries succeed. I don't think public status page is necessary yet but we'll prepare a short note if this persists beyond 30m.
liaison-aws: CDN provider confirmed root cause was a config race; they rolled back and re-deployed stable config. Their telemetry shows errors 502/504 peaked ~18m and are now returning to baseline.
matt (sre): once we quiet alerts, we should schedule follow-up: 1) dashboard and alert changes (owner: matt), 2) runbook update to include CDN propagation flaps (owner: devon), 3) add synthetic checks (owner: ashley), 4) retro w/ provider (owner: liaison-aws).
ashley (oncall): noted. Handoff: devon, I'm going offline in ~20m — if errors stay low, I'll close this thread and unmute paging. If it flares, please take over.
devon (prev-oncall): I'll take if needed. thanks for running the mitigation.
ashley (oncall): closing loop: 5xx rate now down to 0.4% for 5m. gateway timeout tweak helped reduce queuing. ops-bot re-enabled edge-proxy-23 for canary traffic. monitoring closely.
ops-bot: edge-proxy-23 returned to rotation (canary) — health checks OK.
ashley (oncall): unmuting original pager but with new window thresholds in place. final follow-ups to track in TCK-452 and dashboard ticket GRAF-129.
matt (sre): adding action items to our SRE board and will schedule a short postmortem tomorrow. thanks all. :thumbsup:
product-rotations: thanks team. will stand by for comms if needed.
ashley (oncall): thread will remain open for handoff. handing to devon at 21:40 UTC.
devon (prev-oncall): taking handoff at 21:40 UTC. I'll do a 30m watch then close if stable.
